## Description {#details}

<p>This file implements a set that has insertion order iteration characteristics.</p>


<p>This is useful for keeping a set of things that need to be visited later but in a deterministic order (insertion order). The interface is purposefully minimal.</p>


<p>This file defines SetVector and SmallSetVector, which performs no allocations if the SetVector has less than a certain number of elements.</p>
